$comment: THE ROSTER. Single source of truth for the sponsor wall, on every surface. Add a member and it appears on the vfairness offering page, the vfairness docs landing, the platform app and the platform docs landing, with no other edit. Only tiers that carry PUBLIC NAMING appear here: Supporters fund the work but are not listed, because naming everyone who pays anything would publish how much comes in. Slots are how many placements the wall shows; open ones render as available inventory rather than as absence.

cta.label: Become a sponsor
cta.note: Sponsorship opens once GitHub has approved our Sponsors profile. Beta prices apply.

tiers.label: Corporate Patrons
tiers.perk: Company logo on every wall, a named backer credit, and Platform Pro for the team

tiers.label: Patrons
tiers.perk: Named on every wall and in the project credits, with Platform Pro included

partners.$comment: NOT a sponsorship tier. Academic and research partners are collaborations the team decides on internally: nobody buys a place here, so there is no price, no slot count and no 'your logo here'. Add a partner as {name, logo, url, since}; logo is a path or URL to a square-ish SVG/PNG, shown in greyscale until hovered.
partners.label: Academic & research partners
partners.perk: Universities and research institutes we work with on fairness methods, evaluation data and independent review. Partnerships are chosen by the team, never bought.
